q: Compare last week's performance against this week and identify the likely causes.

checks.what: tool: compares against last week or same weekdays last week

answer:
Net sales fell to ₹175,407 this week (12–14 Oct) from ₹356,317 last week (5–7 Oct); orders, ad spend and profit moved down too — the data shows the drop was driven mostly by far fewer orders.  

Evidence (measured)
- Net sales: Last week ₹356,317 → This week ₹175,407 (Measured)  
- Orders: Last week 188 → This week 93 (Measured)  
- Ad spend (platform reports): Last week ₹215,617 → This week ₹118,271 (Measured)  
- Net profit (P&L basis): Last week ₹-19,773 → This week ₹-6,295 (Measured)  
- Net ROAS (P&L basis): Last week 0.908 → This week 0.947 (Measured)

Likely causes (diagnosis engine results — arithmetic splits and suggested contributors)
- Primary driver: lower order volume — the decomposition shows Orders explain the largest share of the Net Sales decline (orders fell ~40–45% and account for most of the sales gap). (Measured / Decomposed)  
- Secondary driver: Average order value moved down slightly (small negative contribution vs orders). (Measured / Decomposed)  
- Media impact: ad spend fell substantially (Measured) and platform-level drops concentrate the change — Meta and Google both show large falls in sales; several ads that previously drove meaningful sales went to zero (examples flagged). (Measured / Likely contributor)  
- Other lines (returns, discounts, COGS) made smaller arithmetic contributions to the change; the decomposition reconciles exactly. (Measured / Decomposed)

Confidence & caveats
- Periods: This week = 2026-10-12..2026-10-14 (Mon–Wed, today partial); comparison = 2026-10-05..2026-10-07. Data note: 2026-10-14 is partial. (Data freshness warning)  
- The decomposition is an exact accounting split (measured); calling any upstream factor a confirmed cause requires targeted causal tests. The diagnosis flagged orders and reduced ad activity as the top contributors and named specific ads/platforms to inspect.
